free_tier.stated: 4 GB per file via URL upload, ~2,800 MB via browser upload. No documented total storage cap per account; Files / Addons / Mods tabs are all upload surfaces on a free account.

retention.stated: per-object-cap: 4,000 MB per file (URL upload) / ~2,800 MB (browser upload); uploads cannot be resumed and time out after 12 hours; no total-account cap documented. Retention: indefinite while the page exists; a page can be deleted by staff.

egress.terms: Free public downloads from media.moddb.com; no metered egress documented and no speed cap published.

tooling: Web upload form (requires member login); no public write API. Read path is plain HTTP GET on media.moddb.com. 'Click to connect via Steam' means account creation chains off an existing Steam identity.
chaining: 4 GB per file x unlimited files x unlimited addon pages x free accounts. Also: URL-upload means the source file can live on another free host, so ModDB acts as a free second copy / re-distribution mirror rather than primary storage.
limits_note: per-object-cap: 4,000 MB per file (URL upload) / ~2,800 MB (browser upload); uploads cannot be resumed and time out after 12 hours; no total-account cap documented. Retention: indefinite while the page exists; a page can be deleted by staff.
reliability_note: Browser-upload path is fragile above ~2.8 GB and there is no resume, so a failed 12-hour upload wastes the slot. media.moddb.com answered 200 with real bytes (238,600) on probe, but the site root returns 503 to datacenter egress — expect intermittent blocking.

evidence.proved: staff (TKAzA): 'we support files up to 4GB'; founder (INtense!): 'uploading a file from your computer currently supports only 2800mb, if you upload from a url you can do 4000mb+'
'Files' tab for tools, 'Addons' for mods, 'Mods' for total conversions
probe: GET -> 200, 238600 bytes — CDN serves originals anonymously
